docker-compose.yml.text:
services:
  web:
    image: ghcr.io/acme/storefront:2.14.3
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://store:s3cret@db:5432/storefront
      REDIS_HOST: cache
      LOG_LEVEL: info
    depends_on:
      - db
      - cache

  db:
    image: postgres:16.4
    volumes:
      - /srv/storefront/pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: store
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: s3cret
      POSTGRES_DB: storefront

  cache:
    image: redis:7.2.5-alpine

jinja_literals.txt.text:
This document talks about Jinja itself.
A variable looks like {{ user.name }} and a tag looks like {% if x %}.
Comments are written {# like this #}. Raw blocks: {% raw %}{{ x }}{% endraw %}
Edge cases: {{{ triple }}}, {%- trimmed -%}, {#- c -#}, lone { and } and }}.
Server: db01.example.com at 192.168.1.10

k8s-deployment.yaml.text:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payments-api
  namespace: payments
  labels:
    app: payments-api
    tier: backend
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payments-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: payments-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: payments-api
          image: registry.acme.io/payments/api:1.22.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8443
          env:
            - name: UPSTREAM_URL
              value: "https://ledger.internal.acme.io/v2"
            - name: NODE_IP
              value: "172.16.4.21"
          resources:
            limits:
              memory: "512Mi"
              cpu: "500m"
